params.message:
Several people can take a note over

"Wie neemt het over" was one free text field. A note can be passed on to
more than one person, so the form now offers the colleagues from the
Medewerkers group to tick, one or more, and a field for anyone else by
name or role. They are kept on the note as one line of names, so the
list on Bespreken, its filter, the search and the export read them as
before; no migration.
